_doc: Data for scripts/rebrand/rebrand.py. Regexes are Python 're' syntax. Globs are root-relative; '*' stays inside a segment, '**' crosses segments, a pattern without '/' matches the repo root only (use '**/name' for any depth). Globs MUST NOT name a brand segment (they are evaluated on both the old and the already-renamed path, which is what makes a re-run idempotent).

fallbackCase._doc: Used (and reported as unmapped casing) when the regex matches a casing that tokenMap lacks, e.g. OmpoS.

brandRegexNotes: Report 01 section 1.1 plus the ompOs alternative (its tokenMap entry had no regex branch). Left edge: lowercase 'ompos' and 'OMPOS' may not follow a letter (compose, decompose, COMPOSE); 'Omp[Oo][Ss]' may follow a lowercase letter or digit (theOmpOS) but not an uppercase one. Right edge: never a lowercase letter (ompost, Omposs). The report-01 alternative (?<=[a-z])Omp[Oo][Ss] is subsumed by (?<![A-Z]) and dropped.

engineAdapters._doc: Two lists, both data. keepPatterns = external omp engine tokens that are NEVER renamed and that veto any rename overlapping them (counted in the report as proof; leftNot is a character class the character before a match must NOT be; censusKey = counted by the omp census scan instead of a regex). productAbbreviations = first-party identifiers where Omp abbreviates the product, not the engine: always renamed (exact identifier match, in contents and in path segments). engineAdapterRules = first-party identifiers that name the engine integration (OmpLauncher, OmpAcpClient, FakeOmp): kept by default, renamed only with --engine-adapters rename. Even then bare omp, Omp as a stand-alone word, OMP_* and every keepPattern stay.
